description: This file defines an internal interface IGrainTimerRegistry responsible for tracking the creation and disposal of grain timers within the Orleans runtime system.

classes.name: IGrainTimerRegistry
classes.description: An internal interface for recording grain timer creation and disposal events.

methods.name: OnTimerCreated
methods.description: Notify the registry that a new grain timer has been created.

methods.name: OnTimerDisposed
methods.description: Notify the registry that a grain timer has been disposed.
